creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Neural Networks

learningObjectives: Identify the input layer, hidden layers, and output layer of a fully connected feedforward network
Distinguish weights, which connect neurons in adjacent layers, from biases, which add one term per neuron in the hidden and output layers
Calculate the total parameter count using weights = neurons x neurons x (layers - 1) and biases = neurons x (layers - 1)
Predict how moving the Layers slider (2-7) versus the Neurons/Layer slider (2-10) changes the Total Parameters display, and explain why neuron count grows the total quadratically
Explain why the input layer contributes no weights or biases to the parameter count
